mapper.select: SELECT c.COST_YM AS "yearMonth",c.DEV_ID AS "developerId",c.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", c.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",j.CODE_NM AS "jobName", c.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",c.ASGN_MM AS "mm",c.SALES_AMT AS "revenue", c.LABOR_ALLOC_AMT AS "labor",c.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team",c.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=c.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=c.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD WHERE c.COST_YM=#{yearMonth} ORDER BY c.ASGN_ID

SELECT a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", a.DEV_ID AS "developerId", d.DEV_NM AS "developerName", d.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", COALESCE(e.CODE_NM,d.EMP_TYPE_CD) AS "employeeTypeName", a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", a.INPUT_END_DT AS "renewalDate", a.CTRT_MM AS "contractMm",
COALESCE(m.APLY_UPRC,0) COALESCE(m.APLY_UPRC,h.NEW_UPRC,a.BILL_UPRC,0) AS "currentUnitPrice", a.ASGN_STAT_CD AS "assignmentStatus", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "projectStatus" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE e ON e.CODE_GRP_ID='EMP_TYPE' AND e.CODE=d.EMP_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m ON m.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND m.INPUT_YM=#{yearMonth} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.NEW_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL AND x.APLY_DT < (to_date(#{yearMonth},'YYYYMM')+interval '1 month')::date ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) h ON true ORDER BY a.ASGN_ID
